name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: HBD combobox / autocomplete: a filterable text input + listbox suggestion panel following the APG aria-activedescendant pattern (DOM focus STAYS on the input). Three modes — autocomplete (free text), strict (must match a listed option, reverts on blur), multi (in-field removable chips). Debounced filtering, no-filter server-search mode (onSearch) with a loading spinner, imperative setOptions() for async data, controlled-first value+onValueChange (single) / values+onValuesChange (multi) with uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultValues fallbacks. Keyboard: ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move the active option, Enter selects, Escape closes+reverts, Tab closes, Backspace removes the last chip in multi mode. Authors options declaratively with Combobox.Option / Combobox.Group (re-exported from @hbd/select). Panel anchored with @floating-ui/react (fixed strategy). Reuses @hbd/input's .hbd-field chrome and @hbd/select's .hbd-field__select-panel / .hbd-field__option styles.
